result.brief: 提出 CADRE 因果扩散表征自编码器族，覆盖多种时空压缩率，系统研究压缩位置与程度对交互式视频世界模型延迟-质量权衡的影响，并给出操纵与导航任务的压缩选择规律。
result.reason: Builds causal diffusion representation autoencoders (CADRE) at multiple spatio-temporal compressions and studies their effect on interactive video world models, directly addressing RAE and latent-space design.
